result.rationale: The finding describes no actual defect. TopicEmbed.import's regex `/^https?\:\/\//` accepting http:// URLs is intentional and harmless — feed items on http:// hosts are legitimately imported. TopicRetriever's `invalid_host?` check (`SiteSetting.embeddable_host != URI(@embed_url).host`) only governs whether the retriever fetches a remote URL, a different code path serving a different purpose. Nothing in the diff shows the two contracts producing broken behavior, data loss, or inconsistency; the claim of a 'different URL contract' causing a problem is speculative with no concrete mechanism.

adjudication.rationale: The finding claims there's a URL contract mismatch between TopicEmbed.import's regex and TopicRetriever's URI.host check. Looking at the diff: TopicEmbed.import (line 11) uses `url =~ /^https?\:\/\//` which accepts both http:// and https:// URLs. TopicRetriever.invalid_host? compares `SiteSetting.embeddable_host != URI(@embed_url).host` - this extracts the host from the URL, not rejecting http://. Both methods work with full URLs containing http:// or https://. The finding misreads the code - there's no contract mismatch where one accepts and one rejects http:// URLs. URI(@embed_url).host simply extracts the hostname portion, it doesn't reject URLs based on scheme.
